quote: Fear asks what will happen if you leap. Courage asks what slowly dies if you stay on the ledge.
reflection: We obsess over the danger of moving forward, rarely noticing the quiet cost of standing still. Safety can become its own slow erosion.
question: What is one thing fear is convincing you to postpone right now?
